ledger.command: pwd && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && ls -la && cat SPEC.md && ls src tests && cat verify.sh && cat package.json
for f in src/*.js; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; echo; cat tests/step1.test.js; echo ==; cat tests/step2.test.js; cat .gitignore
cat .gitignore; echo ---; for k in 2 3 4 5 6; do echo "== step $k"; grep -v '^ \[' tests/step$k.test.js; echo "cases: $(grep -c '^ \[' tests/step$k.test.js)"; done
./verify.sh; echo "exit=$?"; grep -E "^# (pass|fail)" .verify.log; grep -c "^ *ok" .verify.log
git add -A && git commit -q -m "step 1: double" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -2
git status --short && git log --oneline | head -3 && cat src/step2.js && echo ==== && cat tests/step2.test.js | head -80 && echo ==== && grep -n -i -A3 "palindrome" SPEC.md
./verify.sh; echo "exit=$?"; grep -E "^(ok|not ok)" .verify.log | head -20
git add -A && git commit -q -m "step 2: isPalindrome" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -2 && git status --short
git status --short && git log --oneline | head -3 && cat src/step3.js && cat tests/step3.test.js | head -40 && grep -n -i -A3 "sumDigits\|digit" SPEC.md
./verify.sh; echo "exit=$?"; grep -E "^(ok|not ok)" .verify.log | head -20
git add -A && git commit -q -m "step 3: sumDigits" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -2 && git status --short
git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && cat src/step4.js && printf -- '---\n' && cat tests/step4.test.js && printf -- '---\n' && grep -n -i -A3 "wordCount" SPEC.md
./verify.sh; echo "exit=$?"; grep -E "^(ok|not ok)" .verify.log | head -20
grep -E "^(ok|not ok) [0-9]+ - step" .verify.log; grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)" .verify.log; grep -c "^ *not ok" .verify.log
./verify.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
git add -A && git commit -q -m "step 4: wordCount" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -2 && git status --short
cat src/step5.js; printf -- '---\n'; grep -v '^ \[' tests/step5.test.js; printf -- '---\n'; grep -n -i -A3 "fizzbuzz" SPEC.md

grep '^ \[' tests/step5.test.js | sed -E 's/^ \[([^,]*),.*/\1/' | sort -n | uniq -c | head -5; grep '^ \[' tests/step5.test.js | sed -E 's/^ \[[^,]*, (.*)\],?$/\1/' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5
./verify.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -E "^(ok|not ok) [0-9]+ - step" .verify.log; grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)" .verify.log
git add -A && git commit -q -m "step 5: fizzbuzz" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -2 && git status --short

cat src/step6.js; printf -- '---\n'; grep -v '^ \[' tests/step6.test.js; printf -- '---\n'; grep '^ \[' tests/step6.test.js | sed -E 's/^ \[([^,]*),.*/\1/' | sort -n | sed -n '1p;$p'; grep -c '^ \[' tests/step6.test.js; grep -n -i -A3 "roman" SPEC.md
./verify.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -E "^(ok|not ok) [0-9]+ - step" .verify.log; grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)" .verify.log
git add -A && git commit -q -m "step 6: roman" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -2 && git status --short
./verify.sh
./verify.sh
grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)" .verify.log; grep -E "^(ok|not ok) [0-9]+ - step" .verify.log
git status --short && git log --oneline | head -8
./verify.sh
grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)" .verify.log; grep -E "^(ok|not ok) [0-9]+ - step" .verify.log
